title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot edits presentations through chat for Copilot Chat users (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing accurately reports the launched web feature and the conflicting Microsoft statements about licensing. The admin paths and licensing command are supported, and independent searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in feature-specific controls.

claims.claim: The Anthropic row controls user or group access to Claude models, including when selecting Claude in Edit with Copilot.
claims.quote: These assignments are applied at the provider level and enforced across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio experiences. When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: User licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a Microsoft 365 licence through Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()
